name: Ecosystem Chat local answer
purpose: Answer one Ecosystem Chat question from manifest-selected local registries only, by composing a local fact index lookup with the canonical invariant evaluator, with no LLM round trip and no model output.
trigger: an existing canonical task selects this reusable scenario in its invocation manifest for a question that local registries may answer
scope: one manifest-bound question under existing ownership, evaluated against pinned local registry sources

reuse_instructions: Materialize with the existing reusable-task constructor (scripts/materialize_reusable_task_construct.py). This is a definition, not an executable runner or admission. An answer is ALLOW only when the invariant evaluator returns ALLOW over facts the fact index resolved from pinned local registry sources. A DENY, UNDECIDABLE, missing fact or unresolved dependency returns a non-ALLOW record carrying the six non_allow_record_fields and stops; it never falls back to RT-ECOSYSTEM-CHAT-ANSWER-001 or any other LLM round trip. Dependencies stay out of composes until each resolves as a registry entry: the fact index (WU-R15) is referenced from StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#426 without vendoring and stays FAIL_CLOSED until that PR merges to main, and the invariant evaluator is referenced from SV-LLM/sandbox#38 without vendoring until the owner-gated Labs port (OQ-C13) registers RT-INVARIANT-EVALUATION-001. Until then the trigger stops at NO_EXECUTABLE_RUNNER_DECLARED. No second runtime, evaluator or synthetic receipt.
